title: Prebble's Legacy Of Untruths Continues
content:
28 April 1997

Prebble's Legacy Of Untruths Continues

  • Deborah Morris
Youth Affairs

The Goss this week published an unrepentant apology after Hon Deborah Morris complained to Richard Prebble about an article in last week's edition.

``Richard Prebble has never been one to say anything straight and mean it. His pretence at apologising for so blatantly getting the facts wrong are no exception. His allegation in last week's Goss that I condone 12 year olds smoking cannabis brought a swift response.
